messages:
rachael (People Ops): Heads up — we've got 3 visitors today: 3:15pm, 3:30pm, and 4:00pm. One (Sam from IndusLabs) is bringing demo gear. Can we coordinate badges, seating, and package flow?
frontdesk-bot: New package scanned 11:08 AM: 'IndusLabs - Sensitive Kit' arrived. Placed in Locker A7. Code: `LCKR-A7`. :package:
alex: @rachael can we reserve the Green Room guest table for Sam's demo at 3:15? He needs space for a laptop + small crate.
mohit: I'll bring a power strip and HDMI. I can move the crate from A7 to the Green Room at ~2:50. Please label anything fragile.
jamie: small ask — apparently it's Sam's birthday today. Can we stash a tiny cake in the office fridge? I'll label it clearly 'Sam bday - DO NOT EAT'. :cake: :sweat_smile:
sarah: @frontdesk-bot can you pre-print a temp guest badge for 'Sam Patel / IndusLabs' for 3:15pm and mark it with 'equipment' access?
frontdesk-bot: Badge printed: Sam Patel (temp-#0587). QR check-in: https://kiosk.company/checkin/0587. Tagged notes: equipment access, escort required.
deliveries-bot: Additional parcel scanned 11:22 AM: 'Fragile - demo electronics' — placed with other IndusLabs items in A7.
rachael (People Ops): Great — @alex Green Room reserved 3:00–4:00. @jamie fridge top shelf saved for cake (please label). @mohit please unplug the power strip after 4:15 so it doesn't trip the breakers. :thumbsup:
alex: Thanks — I'll set up the table and leave a sign 'Demo in progress'.
jamie: cake secured in fridge. Uploading pic: https://img.company/internal/cake-sam.jpg :party_parrot:
sarah: I'll meet them at the lobby at 3:10 and hand over the badge. Front Desk — please note 'equipment' + locker code in the visitor log.
rachael (People Ops): Closing the loop: locker LCKR-A7 contains IndusLabs demo gear (two parcels). Green Room reserved 3–4pm for Sam. Temp badge #0587 printed. Cake in fridge top shelf labeled. Anything else?
mohit: All set from infra. I'll be near the Green Room at 2:45 to help move stuff.
frontdesk-bot: Visitor log updated: Sam Patel — IndusLabs — 3:15pm — escort: Sarah — notes: equipment, temp-#0587.
rachael (People Ops): Thanks everyone! :tada:
